description: Wait for the next text message on one of your MeiSIM numbers and return it. Blocks up to timeout_seconds (default 30, max 50). Pass since as the time you started waiting (default: now) so an older message is not mistaken for the new one. If nothing arrives, received is false; call again to keep waiting. Needs your API key.

number.description: One of your numbers. Omit to watch every number on the account.

since.description: ISO 8601; only a message received after this counts. Default: now.

name: wait_for_message
title: Wait for the next text
